author: t. c. reyes
title: Hicks and Isaak named to Academic All-District basketball team
text:
Brooklyn Hicks and Tyler Isaak were named to the College Sports Communicators Academic All-District team, the organization announced on Mar. 24.
The recognition highlights both players’ achievements in athletics and academics during the basketball season. To be eligible for this honor, student-athletes must maintain at least a 3.50 cumulative grade point average while participating in at least 90 percent of their team’s contests during the season.
Hicks, a junior from Lacey, Washington, played in all 34 games for Montana this season and started the final six. He was third on the team in scoring with an average of nine points per game and ranked fifth in rebounding with nearly four per contest. Hicks is majoring in communications and holds a cumulative GPA of 3.63.
Isaak, also a junior but from Danville, California, appeared in every game as well and started 18 times for Montana. He averaged 6.1 points, 2.8 rebounds, and 2.3 assists per game while leading his team with a 2.44 assist-to-turnover ratio—a mark among the best in the conference according to statistics provided by Montana Grizzlies Men’s Basketball staff. Isaak is also majoring in communications with a cumulative GPA of 3.75.
Both players contributed significantly on the court while maintaining high academic standards throughout the competition season.
